driver.definition: theta = angle (deg) between the humerus direction (head->tail of upperarm_<side>) and the downward trunk axis (-(head->tail of spine_03)); lam = hl^2/(hl^2+ha^2) with hl, ha the lateral and anterior components of the humerus direction in the trunk frame (lam=1 when both ~0)

composition: rest_posed = rest + [existing abduction terms] + a(theta_L,lam_L)*D_L + a(theta_R,lam_R)*D_R, then ordinary skinning (vertex morph add before skinning)

mirror.mirror_map_by: exact rest-space mirror of the vertex position (rounded 1e-5)
